0022600208.text: The Houston Rockets (7-3, 4-1 at home) host the Denver Nuggets (5-3) in the Rockets' 11th game of the season, with Houston 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 6th in the West, after a two-game losing streak. Denver is 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and 9th in the West, riding a two-game winning streak, and the Rockets are without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) while the Nuggets are without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, the Rockets lost 1-3 to Denver in the 2025-26 season, and their last meeting was a 129-93 Denver win in Denver on March 11, 2026.
